name: @investing-app/lint
description: ESLint toolchain for the frontend workspace. A standalone npm project (NOT a root workspace, own lockfile): typescript-eslint needs the classic TypeScript JS API (typescript < 6.1) while the apps compile with TypeScript 7, which ships none, and workspace hoisting would resolve ts-api-utils against the root TypeScript 7. Install with `npm run lint:install` at the repo root.
